```python
def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    face_value = 5_000_000
    coupon_rate = 0.025
    market_interest_rate = 0.03
    years = 3

    # Calculate the present value of annual interest payments and principal
    annual_coupon = face_value * coupon_rate
    bonds_payable = sum(
        annual_coupon / (1 + market_interest_rate) ** year
        for year in range(1, years + 1)
    )
    bonds_payable += face_value / (1 + market_interest_rate) ** years

    # Return the issue-date carrying amount, rounded to three decimal places
    return round(bonds_payable, 3)
```
